title: 大嘴哥的 DSH 插件短名单
description: 我自己装、自己在用的 DSH 插件。装插件不用再翻几千条目录。

description.zh: 右侧设计工作台：一句话出几个方向的网页 / App 界面 / 海报 / 幻灯片，点元素回传对话，调设计变量、对比版本
description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar: generated web / app / poster / slide screens on a canvas, click an element to send it back to the chat.

description.zh: 歸藏设计：网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、去 AI 味四个 skill 加语气档案，共用一套设计系统，带作品库，一键做同款
description.en: Guizang design plugin: web PPT, social cards, page layout and humanizer skills sharing one design system, plus a works library and voice profile.

description.zh: 自媒体工作台：一句话记灵感，一键生成口播脚本、标题、封面、配图和分镜；稿子拖到日历排期，发完回来复盘
description.en: Media desk: capture an idea in one line, generate script, titles, cover, images and storyboard, schedule posts and review the results.

description.zh: 可视化插件市场：在 DSH 里逛、搜、一键装社区插件，也能更新和卸载
description.en: Visual plugin market inside DSH: browse, search and one-click install community plugins, with update and uninstall.

description.zh: 提示词链式增强：继续生成 / 重新生成 / 历史回退 / 差异逐行对比，结果回填输入框
description.en: Prompt chain enhancer: continue, regenerate, roll back through history and diff line by line; the result goes back into the input box.

description.zh: 网页搜索与抓取的多来源故障转移：TinyFish → Tavily → 官方搜索依次兜底，同平台多账号轮转分摊，带用量展示
description.en: Composite web-search and fetch provider that fails over TinyFish → Tavily → official DeepSeek and spreads requests across accounts.

description.zh: ChatGPT / Codex 登录与账号管理：浏览器授权登录、默认模型与思考强度，输入框旁看用量和剩余额度
description.en: Standalone ChatGPT / Codex OAuth account management: browser login, default model and reasoning effort, usage and quota next to the input.

description.zh: fnOS 系统集成：主题跟随、授权目录管理、在 fnOS 应用里打开文件、把窗口标题同步给 fnOS
description.en: fnOS-specific integrations: follow the NAS theme, manage authorized directories, open files in fnOS apps and sync the window title.

description.zh: Agentero 科研工作台：文献库、笔记、PDF 阅读器搬进 DSH，右侧读论文、中间对话，资料全留在本地
description.en: Agentero research workbench: local-first literature library, notes and PDF reader inside DSH, so the Agent can query your own papers.

description.zh: 常驻 Bot 团队：主 Bot、Bot 之间互发消息、群聊、团队记忆、权限预设和用量统计
description.en: DS Bot: a team of long-lived Bots with Main Bots, Bot-to-Bot messages, group chats, memory, permission presets and usage stats.

description.zh: 上下文洞察与管理：跨会话用量看板、上下文组成与趋势、/context 命令、多 Agent 舰队视图
description.en: Context insight and management: cross-session usage dashboard, context composition and trends, /context command and a multi-agent fleet view.
